Foreign dividends incur 25% US withholding tax.

faq.question: What is the TCS rate on LRS investments?
faq.answer: Budget 2026 rule: 20% TCS applies on LRS remittances for investment exceeding ₹10 lakh per financial year. TCS is not a tax cost — it is adjustable against total ITR tax liability.

faq.question: What is the annual LRS limit?
faq.answer: RBI allows up to USD 250,000 per financial year per resident Indian individual.

faq.question: What platform fees apply?
faq.answer: Forex markup (0.5%-1.5%) + bank wire fee + withdrawal fees ($5-$11).
